dialogues.speaker: Malusha
dialogues.text: ...Don't look at me like that. It's not like those idiots are dead or anything.

dialogues.speaker: Malusha
dialogues.text: Old Man Nikita has Captain Inga doing menial chores now as punishment for being reckless in command earlier. The others were sent home on leave for emotional distress. That's all.

dialogues.speaker: Malusha
dialogues.text: But Lauri, that idiot, he had to play the hero and get himself seriously hurt... Tch, I told him that he shouldn't try to save me, no matter what happened. But he just had to act tough...
